The '''Office of Republic Justice''' was an organization that was affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]] was imprisoned by the Republic inside a holding faciliy on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after she announced that the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] was to secede from the Republic. Wren's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Warlan Presvere Tosk|Warlan Tosk]] subsequently broke the former senator out of the facility, and the pair fled from Coruscant in a stolen [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. In the aftermath of their escape, the Office of Republic Justice placed [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] of 35,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and 20,000 credits on Wren and Tosk respectively.
